Synthetic clearing-house files for `tests/maslaka.unit.ts` and the visual check of `/my` (W3). **Fixtures, not real data:** every person,
number and amount is invented; the structure follows the regulator's holdings-interface XSD v008 (see `src/lib/maslaka.ts`). The
companies' registration numbers and the fund numbers are public (data.gov.il) so the matcher can find fox tracks.
